data.text:
Task 2 is complete. Summary:

## Implemented
- **`src/core/config-serve.ts`** — `ServeConfig`, `DEFAULT_SERVE_CONFIG` (port `4173`, debounce `100`), `isValidPort`, and `validateServeConfig` (partial merge + strict validation).
- **`src/core/config.ts` / `src/index.ts`** — public `serve` wiring through `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, `defineConfig`, `OsqUserConfig`, and exports.
- **`src/core/web-static.ts`** — `resolveUiDir()` for both tsx/compiled layouts, self-only CSP, MIME map, fingerprint detection, and traversal/listing-safe `resolveStaticFile` with no SPA fallback.
- **`src/core/web-server.ts`** — loopback-only `startWebServer` with idempotent close, per-request fresh report/graph/inbox/change derivation, deterministic UTF-8 JSON + `no-store`, no CORS, GET/HEAD-only gating before routing, typed 404/409 selector mapping, JSON errors that keep the listener alive, and CSP/cache-controlled static delivery.
- **`src/cli/serve.ts` + `src/cli/index.ts`** — `osq serve [--port <n>] [--open]`, strict integer port parsing, platform browser launch without a dependency, signal/abort shutdown, and single actionable error + nonzero status on failure.
- **Tests** — `tests/serve.test.ts` (new) plus serve additions to `tests/config.test.ts`.

## Verification
```
node --import tsx --test tests/serve.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts tests/import-graph.test.ts tests/line-budget.test.ts
```
49/49 pass. Also clean: `pnpm tsc --noEmit`, `pnpm test` (1202 pass), `pnpm lint`.

Result written to `openspec/changes/044-read-only-dashboard/.run/results/2.md`.
